summary.headline: Book Completion and Colophon
summary.text: Concluding astrological doctrine explains how malefics and fortunes affect the ascendant and angles of the year, including conjunctions and the stronger planet’s nature. A colophon completes Messahala’s book, translated from Arabic into Latin by John of Seville in Limia.
